The UC Immigration Legal Services Center (UCIMM) is a college-based, immigration legal services program headquartered at the UC Davis School of Law with staff present and providing services at nine UC campuses. We provide advice and counsel and direct legal representation in immigration matters, and engage in education and outreach, advocacy, and other strategic initiatives. We offer free services to enrolled undocumented UC students and students from mixed status families; family members of enrolled UC students; and UC staff, at nine UC campuses.

Under the supervision of the Executive Director, the Operations Director will serve as a member of UCIMM’s senior leadership team. This position is responsible for the development, implementation, and enhancement of department processes, systems, and tools, including the identification and coordination of grant and funding opportunities; support for proposal development and grant administration; and the development and implementation of compliance practices and procedures to ensure adherence to relevant laws, regulations, policies, and industry standards.

The UC Davis School of Law is a top tier US law school finishing high in every ranking of note, but we value diversity, equity and inclusion as highly as academic excellence. The mission of the School of Law is to be a nationally and internationally recognized leader in the development and dissemination of legal knowledge, as well as the education of students to become socially responsible lawyers committed to professional excellence and high ethical standards, and to provide significant public service through law reform and professional activities. Through its faculty, students, and graduates, the School of Law seeks to make substantial contributions toward solving the complex legal problems confronting our society. The outstanding scholarly reputation, high rankings, small size, dedicated faculty of internationally renowned scholars, and uniquely supportive learning environment combine for an experience of legal education that is second to none to the students. The UC Davis School of Law offers a three-year full-time program leading to the Juris Doctor Degree, as well as programs for LL.M. and combined degrees.

The UC Immigration Legal Services Center (UCIMM) is a college-based, immigration legal services program headquartered at the UC Davis School of Law with staff providing services at all UC campuses. We provide advice and counsel and direct legal representation in immigration matters, and engage in education and outreach, advocacy, and other strategic initiatives. We offer free services to enrolled undocumented and other immigrant UC students, including U.S. citizens in mixed status families; UC staff and faculty, and low-income immediate family members of enrolled UC students, and some alumni.
